decisions.decision: The nearest frozen weekend is 2026-08-22 through 2026-08-23 in Europe/Kaliningrad and uses the corpus reference clock 2026-08-21T09:00:00+02:00.
The typical Weekend projection contains exactly event.real.7807 and event.real.7906. Both belong to Saturday; Sunday remains visibly empty rather than receiving fabricated data.
event.real.7888 is not materialized in Weekend even though its source date is Saturday: frozen surface expectations classify exhibition-like events outside the primary date/weekend listing.

Foundations, shell, listing cards, mobile rail rows, state action and shared navigation primitives are reused. Only range navigation, two-day grouping and weekend timeline behavior are new semantic delta.
Stress coverage uses six range links, compact desktop wrapping, two time rows and a single-day event concentration. It does not clone or mutate frozen events to simulate density.
